sn35.156:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhuṃ aniccanti passati. sāssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.
sn35.156:1.6: yeva bhikkhave, bhikkhu sotaṃ aniccanti passati …pe… ghānaṃ aniccanti passati …pe… jivhaṃ aniccanti passati aniccanti
sn35.156:1.11: aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu manaṃ aniccanti passati sāssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.
